content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"PM SVANidhi stands for \"PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi\" [E01]. Its intended beneficiary group is street vendors, including hawkers, thelewala, rehriwala, and others engaged in small-scale vending activities [E01]. The scheme specifically targets vendors in possession of a Certificate of Vending/Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), vendors identified in surveys but not yet issued certificates, vendors left out of surveys who have received a Letter of Recommendation (LoR), and vendors from surrounding development/peri-urban/rural areas vending within ULB geographical limits with a LoR [E02].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"PM SVANidhi stands for PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"The scheme targets street vendors including hawkers, thelewala, rehriwala, and others engaged in small-scale vending activities","evidence_ids":["E01"]},{"claim":"Eligible beneficiaries include vendors with Certificate of Vending/Identity Card, identified vendors without certificates, vendors left out of surveys with LoR, and vendors from surrounding areas with LoR","evidence_ids":["E02"]}]}
